elasticity.description: How rigid the stem is. 0 = rope (uniform droop), 1 = stiff rod (only the tip bends).

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: closed-form lerps each segment toward gravity; chain is a forward-kinematic cantilever where each segment rotates by an angle that grows along the stem.

weight.description: How the bend is spread over a path, in chain mode. Along each path: from its base to its tip, so a short path bends more at a place than a long one. By place: by the distance from the root, the spot on the parent the path grows from, so paths that lie on top of each other bend together. By place, paths also move with the spot on their parent.

reach.description: By place only: how far from the root the bend reaches its full strength. Alpha of the strength goes from 0 at the root to 1 at the reach. 0 bends every segment fully.

root.description: By place only: where the paths grow from, when their parent is not in the plant, like the hinge of a cap for its rays. A path grows from the point that sits on its parent. Without one it grows from the spot on its parent, or from its own base.
